resources.string: These suggestions come from your open tasks. A task with no time gets 25 minutes. MarbleDo does not read your phone calendar and never moves a task on its own.
How much time do you have?

Tap a task to see what is going on. Nothing changes on its own.
It does not fit here. Try another day, less time, or another window.
Make a task for this slot
This counts tasks that were due in the last 7 days. Focus time is an estimate and archived tasks are left out.
No task was due in this range. Start with one small plan.

For one task without a date, pick a time and say how long it takes.
Leave a little air. Next week is busier than this one.
This rhythm is good. Keep some empty time for surprises and check in next week.
